title: Network Participation Agreements — Disputes Lost in Full and the Claim Run Withholding Share
content:
**Rule.** When Cascade continues recovering an overpayment from the claim payment runs of an agreement under the **Network Participation Agreements**, a history of disputes the practice lost in full raises the share withheld. The run dispute-history adjustment to the continuing run withholding share is set by the agreement's dispute decisions that upheld the overpayment in full and are dated fewer than 24 whole months before today:

- two or more add 4 share points;
- exactly one adds 2 share points;
- none adds nothing.

## Which decisions count

- Only decisions whose outcome upheld the overpayment in full count. A decision that reduced or withdrew the overpayment does not.
- The decision's resolved date must be fewer than 24 whole months before today.
- Whole months are the difference in calendar months from the resolved date to today, less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the resolved date's day of the month.

## Truth table (hypothetical histories)

| Decisions in the last 24 whole months | Upheld in full | Share points added |
|---|---|---|
| 3 (two reduced, one upheld) | 1 | 2 |
| 2 (both upheld) | 2 | 4 |
| 1 (withdrawn) | 0 | None |
| 0 | 0 | None |
